facts.statement: A command combining `python -m pytest` and an application render returned exit code 1 because the environment had no `pytest` module.
The next command explicitly switched to Python standard-library assertions instead of pytest.
The substitute assertions checked ten forecast days, ten render cards, a headline, and zero dependency retries; the command returned exit code 0 and printed `PASS`.
The same successful command invoked the render operation and produced structured render output.
A subsequent UI preview command returned exit code 0.

claim_set.statement: An explicit dependency-related validation failure occurred.
The agent changed validation strategy instead of repeating the unavailable pytest command.
The substitute validation and subsequent UI preview both completed successfully.
